dashboard.label: STIG collection metrics (lookup)
dashboard.description: Complementary Simple XML view using kvstore lookups. Primary UX is the Collection dashboard SplunkUI page.

search.query: | inputlookup stig_checklists | search stig_collection_id="$collection_id$" | fields _key | rename _key AS checklist_id | join type=inner checklist_id [ | inputlookup stig_reviews | fields checklist_id status ] | stats count BY status | sort status

| inputlookup stig_checklists | search stig_collection_id="$collection_id$" | fields _key host_id baseline_id | rename _key AS checklist_id | join type=inner checklist_id [ | inputlookup stig_reviews | search status=open | fields checklist_id group_id rule_id status finding_details updated_at ] | lookup stig_hosts _key AS host_id OUTPUT hostname | table hostname group_id rule_id status finding_details updated_at
